goal: Haskell review: partial functions, laziness leaks, exceptions in pure code and effect boundaries.
use: Haskell review: partial functions, laziness leaks, exceptions in pure code and effect boundaries. Use when asked to review a Haskell project or module.

steps.note: Read the project setup. Cabal or stack files and the compiler flags.
Check partial functions. Flag head, tail and fromJust on external data.
Check laziness. Flag space leaks from lazy accumulation.
Check exceptions. Flag errors thrown from pure code.
Report. Each finding with file and line, severity and the fix.
